name: REBOOT
source:
You open your eyes, hearing a familiar voice call out you.

A voice you've heard so many times... 

...Huh? So many... times?

I... I don't remember how many times... 

...What's going on...?

Who am I?

[Edited from [url=https://lyrvx.itch.io/reboot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你睁开眼睛，听到熟悉的声音在呼唤你。

一个你听过很多次的声音… 

……嗯？这么多次？

我……我不记得第几次了…… 

……这是怎么回事……？

我是谁？
